changelog: New voice command "read last sentence" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ বাক্য পড়ে শোনাও" in Bengali) and only the last sentence before the cursor is read aloud, so you can check a long message one sentence at a time instead of hearing the whole thing from the start. It is the scoped twin of v9.9's "read back". The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 55 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
